config.label: QuickBooks OAuth2 bearer access token
config.description: QuickBooks OAuth2 bearer access token. Expires in 1hr — caller is responsible for refresh via Intuit's OAuth2 auth_code flow.

config.label: QuickBooks company id (realmId)
config.description: QuickBooks company id (realmId). Issued when a user authorizes your app against a specific company.

config.label: QuickBooks environment: 'sandbox' (default) or 'production'
config.description: QuickBooks environment: 'sandbox' (default) or 'production'. Selects sandbox-quickbooks.api.intuit.com vs quickbooks.api.intuit.com.

config.label: QuickBooks API minor version
config.description: QuickBooks API minor version. Defaults to 70.
